newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Abacus Direct upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Abacus Direct upgraded.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said analyst Wayne Johnson raised his rating on Abacus Direct Corp to buy from long-term attractive, based on price and the company's "robust business outlook."
-- In a written statement, Johnson said Abacus boasts a 90 percent recurring revenue rate and over twice the profitability of its nearest competitor.
-- Johnson believes the company's business indications are solid and it could exceed fourth quarter earnings estimates.
-- Analysts expect the company to earn $0.09 a share in the fourth quarter, according to First Call.
